# Phrasing conventions — non-po-invoice-entry-and-approval

- NetSuite navigation as breadcrumbs: "Transactions > Payables > Enter Bills".
- Prior SOP cites as "§6.1 of the prior SOP, SRC-006" (never a bare section number).
- Dollar tiers written as "$5,000 to $25,000" with commas, no "k".
- Pending capture output referred to as "a bill in a pending state" on the
  "AP - Bills Pending Review" saved search (matches invoice-intake-and-capture).
- NetSuite plant segment written as "Class, which the Company uses to designate plant".
